;; D19 demonstration, BEFORE: tetris's shipped line-clear machinery,
;; shrunk to a six-row well.  The board itself needs a visible label
;; column (0-5) and a `%` scratch register purely so per-cell copies can
;; address rows; the rules are games/clones/tetris.txt's line_clear and
;; line_clear_internal with the label sets reduced.

GOAL
Z

WHITESPACE -_

----------0
-XX-------1
XXXXXXXXXX2
--X-------3
XXXXXXXXXX4
-------X--5
%__________

BIND c line_clear "clear one full row"

CMD line_clear_internal
 TRY_ALL
  MATCH1
   FOR r 54321
    ATOMIC
     %r

     ??????????r ??????????r
     ??????????? ??????????!

  ZIP p 43210 q 54321
   ATOMIC
    ATOMIC_VERTICAL
     ??????????q

     ??????????!

    TRY_ALL
     LET_REPEAT 0 10 1 t ?
      FOR * -X
       ATOMIC
        *tp

        ?tq *tq

  MATCH1
   ZIP r 54321 s _5432
    ATOMIC
     %r %_

     r r
     ! s

CMD line_clear
 FOR p 54321
  ATOMIC
   XXXXXXXXXXp

   %_ %p

   CALL line_clear_internal
